intent: Switch between related views in place. Line by default, or segmented, in lg, md, and sm.
useWhen: Grouped settings or detail sections on one page
Two to five peer views sharing one context
Compact local switching such as preview and code
doNotUseWhen: Mutually exclusive form values — use RadioGroup

requirements: Active tab indicated visually and with aria-selected
Disabled tabs stay visible and are not selectable

doNot: Do not invent TabsList, TabsTrigger, or TabsContent cousins
Do not use Tabs for main app navigation — use AppNav
Do not nest tabs inside tabs
snippet: <Tabs defaultValue="overview" variant="line" items={[{ id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', content: '…' }, { id: 'docs', label: 'Docs', content: '…' }]} />
